_comment: Single source of truth for state -> zonal region mapping, read by ingestion/ingest.py. Keys here are the CANONICAL state names (matching src/data/india-states-topo.json's ST_NM property in the frontend, and the output of canonicalize_state_name() in ingest.py) -- not the raw spellings that show up in the source CSVs. Region grouping follows the North/West vs East/South split your interviewee (Hiya) framed the operator strongholds around.
_unmapped_state_policy: Any state_name not found in the lists above is loaded with region = NULL rather than guessed. Check the 'unmapped_states.log' the ingestion script writes after each run and add missing names here -- do not silently default them to a region, that would misrepresent the data in the choropleth.
_note_on_ladakh: Ladakh is listed under North for region-level filtering, but the DataMeet boundaries bundled with the frontend don't include it as its own shape (pre-2019 source), so it won't render as a distinct state on the map -- it'll just be absent there, not misattributed.
